This 4-bdrm, 2.5 bath tucked on nearly .5 acre this stately Colonial delivers the rare combination of generous space, timeless style, and a setting that feels like a retreat while keeping everything you need close by. From the moment you arrive, the setting makes an impression. Framed by mature landscaping the home’s exudes classic elegance and enduring curb appeal. Natural light pours through expansive windows, illuminating rich hardwood floors and beautifully proportioned living spaces. The dramatic 2-story foyer with curved staircase sets the tone.  Inside, gleaming hardwood floors and rich trim flow throughout most of the 1st floor.  The chef’s kitchen features generous workspace, custom cabinetry, large island, granite countertops, walk-in pantry and updated ss appliances opens to the spacious eat-in area and the perfect Sunroom. Breathtaking 2-story family room featuring soaring ceilings, hardwood floors, surrounded by windows, gas fplc and open to the second-floor loft space. Elegant formal living room and dining room spacious enough for large gatherings.  Private office with French doors off foyer, newly installed hrwd, custom built-ins and coffered ceiling. Half bath and laundry rm complete the first level. Upstairs, retreat to four great-sized bedrooms, including a serene primary suite that offers a spa bath, double sinks, and a walk-in closet. Additional bedrooms provide flexibility for family, guests, or a sophisticated work-from-home environment. The lower level is perfect for future expansion of living space for recreation, media and playing. Step outside and discover your own private outdoor retreat overlooking the wooded lot, gardens and covered deck w/awning. Don’t miss this opportunity truly move-in ready with far too many features to list!
